name: Azure Device or Configuration Deleted
description: Entra and Intune devices are the laptops and phones allowed to access company apps. Deleting or altering a device record can drop a machine out of compliance, or hide a device the attacker enrolled. Configuration profiles that enforce disk encryption or PIN can also be removed. This is identity and endpoint control, not just inventory cleanup. Device deletion on executive or admin machines should be confirmed with the owner.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
